label: 01-init-help
stdout:
usage: init_project.py [-h] --target TARGET --name NAME [--scale {S,M,L}]
                       [--profile {general,research}]
                       [--ai-entry {agents,claude} | --no-ai-entry]
                       [--design {secondary,omics,wet_lab,animal,clinical_observational,diagnostic_prognostic,clinical_trial,evidence_synthesis,methods}]
                       [--no-research-folders] [--dry-run] [--date DATE]

Create minimal project records without replacing existing files (stdlib only).

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --target TARGET
  --name NAME
  --scale {S,M,L}
  --profile {general,research}
  --ai-entry {agents,claude}
                        Select host entries; defaults to both. Existing files
                        are preserved.
  --no-ai-entry         Do not create host entry files.
  --design {secondary,omics,wet_lab,animal,clinical_observational,diagnostic_prognostic,clinical_trial,evidence_synthesis,methods}
                        Research study type(s); see references/research-
                        types.md. Repeat for mixed projects.
  --no-research-folders
                        Skip default business-folder README placeholders;
                        preserve an existing project layout. Research records
                        still apply. Does not migrate existing state or paths.
  --dry-run
  --date DATE

label: 04-task-help
stdout:
usage: research_tree.py task [-h] --id ID [--serves SERVES] [--title TITLE]
                             [--input INPUT] [--path PATH]
                             [--status {blocked,cancelled,doing,done,paused,stopped,todo}]
                             [--output OUTPUT] [--by BY]
                             [--rationale RATIONALE] [--evidence EVIDENCE]
                             [--decision DECISION]
                             {add,link,intent,set}

positional arguments:
  {add,link,intent,set}

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --id ID
  --serves SERVES
  --title TITLE         Required for add; new tasks start as todo
  --input INPUT         Versioned artifact input for add: ID@version
  --path PATH
  --status {blocked,cancelled,doing,done,paused,stopped,todo}
  --output OUTPUT       Existing artifact id; done still requires accepted
                        current outputs
  --by BY
  --rationale RATIONALE
  --evidence EVIDENCE
  --decision DECISION   Actual adopted control/resumption decision, not
                        inferred permission

label: 06-run-help
stdout:
usage: run_project.py [-h] --project PROJECT --spec SPEC [--timeout TIMEOUT]
                      ...

Execute explicitly supplied argv, preserving actual run evidence. No shell or
recorded-command replay.

positional arguments:
  command

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --project PROJECT
  --spec SPEC        Project-relative run specification
  --timeout TIMEOUT

label: 07-check-help
stdout:
usage: check_project.py [-h] --project PROJECT [--impact IMPACT]
                        [--require-gate REQUIRE_GATE] [--verify-hashes]

Read-only consistency and transitive-impact checks; never validate scientific
truth.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --project PROJECT
  --impact IMPACT
  --require-gate REQUIRE_GATE
  --verify-hashes

label: 08-decision-help
stdout:
usage: record.py decision [-h] --id ID --title TITLE
                          [--status {proposed,adopted}] [--record RECORD]
                          [--checkpoint CHECKPOINT] [--skipped]
                          [--rationale RATIONALE] [--by BY]
                          [--authorization AUTHORIZATION]
                          [--evidence EVIDENCE]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --id ID
  --title TITLE
  --status {proposed,adopted}
  --record RECORD
  --checkpoint CHECKPOINT
                        CP0-CP9 this decision answers
  --skipped             Checkpoint judged not applicable; requires --rationale
  --rationale RATIONALE
  --by BY
  --authorization AUTHORIZATION
  --evidence EVIDENCE
